hypothesis: R269 逐笔结果显示，A 腿基线发现段 120 笔中 54 笔亏损，亏损中位数约 -4.46%，约四分之一低于 -10%；validation 170 笔中 91 笔亏损，中位数 -5.59%，下四分位约 -9.67%，约四分之一低于 -10%。280/290 笔按 35 日 max_hold 退出。保持信号、评分、历史 HS300、10 仓、T+1 开盘撮合、成本与窗口不变，只增加固定止损，检验能否截断尾部亏损并保留绝对收益。

execution.stop_execution: BacktestEngine uses the strategy panel's forward-adjusted daily OHLC: if open <= stop line fill at open, else if low <= stop line fill at stop line; same-day entry risk exits are disallowed and system tradability/price-limit blocks remain active.

gates.P1: R266 equal-weight 3x/4x/5x control curve and trade cache hashes match finalized evidence, and the 3x R265 parity passes.
gates.P2: After running-panel reload, the strategy and all four referenced factors exist with zero strategy load errors.
gates.G1: 3x full-sample return is positive and retains at least 70% of R266 equal-weight return.
gates.G2: 3x maximum drawdown is no worse than -25%.
gates.G3: 3x rolling one-year positive-return rate is at least 70%.
gates.G5: 3x validation annualized return is at least 5%.
gates.G8: 3x validation return retains at least 70% of the R266 validation return.
gates.R1: 3x full-sample Sharpe is no lower than R266 equal-weight control.
gates.R2: 3x maximum drawdown is no worse than R266 control by more than 3 percentage points.
gates.L1: Full-sample losing-trade mean loss magnitude improves (shrinks) by at least 1 percentage point versus control: compare -mean(loss pnl_pct) among losing completed trades. All full-window trades, including any entry before the window, are counted as before.
gates.L2: Validation-entry losing-trade mean loss magnitude improves (shrinks) by at least 1 percentage point versus control, using completed losses for trades entered on/after 2024-01-01; attribution by entry_date.
gates.L3: The worst completed trade return in the full sample is less negative than control.
gates.L4: The worst validation-entry trade return is less negative than control.
gates.C2: Largest symbol net P&L share is at most 25%.
gates.C3: Top three symbols net P&L share is at most 55%.
gates.C4: Top five symbols net P&L share is at most 75%.
gates.C5: At least 8 distinct validation-entry symbols have positive P&L.
gates.C6: Largest industry gross-profit share is at most 45%.
gates.C7: Largest single-symbol loss is at most 20% of gross profit.
gates.C8: Validation-period largest symbol share of net P&L is at most 35%.

decision_rule: Each fixed-stop variant is judged independently; every P/G/R/L/C gate must pass, otherwise it is rejected. Thresholds and variants cannot be changed after seeing results. A pass permits consideration for separate paper-observation research only, not production deployment.
diagnostics_not_gates: Report stop-exit counts, signed average loss and positive loss magnitude, median losing trade, q10 and worst trade for full, discovery and validation-entry samples.
Report net-P&L concentration and gross-profit-denominator concentration separately; gross-profit shares cannot replace C2-C4.
Report 3x/4x/5x curves and trades with source and cache hashes.
known_limitations: An initial run with the same frozen variants was superseded before finalization after audit corrected the signed loss-improvement gate; the finalized runner must execute all nine system backtests into a fresh cache namespace.
The strategy and validation interval have been studied in previous rounds; this is not an untouched holdout.
The -10%/-15%/-20% bracket is anchored to the R269 discovery-segment loss distribution and frozen before R270 runs.
Daily OHLC cannot establish intraday ordering when a stop and a price-limit condition coincide.
Stop trigger/fill prices use the system strategy panel OHLC fields (forward-adjusted), not tick-level raw fills.
Gap-through-stop losses can exceed the threshold; real fills may be worse than simulated opening/stop-line fills.
Historical HS300 membership is used; industry classification is a current snapshot, not point-in-time.
Discovery/validation trade attribution uses entry_date, so trades spanning the boundary remain assigned to their entry period.
Only 290 baseline trades are available, creating sampling uncertainty in tail quantiles.
Panel reload and a passing historical backtest do not authorize production deployment.
